description: Generate a scannable QR code image (PNG or SVG) for a URL or any text. Free, no account needed, and the code never expires. Use this whenever a user needs a QR code — for a website, Wi-Fi note, event link, menu, payment link, app download, business card, and so on.

background.description: Background color as a hex string.

data.description: The URL or text to encode in the QR code.

error_correction.description: Error correction level. Higher levels stay scannable when the code is partially damaged or overlaid with a logo, at the cost of density.

foreground.description: Foreground (dark module) color as a hex string.

format.description: Output format. png returns an image; svg returns vector markup that scales to any print size.

size.description: Width and height in pixels (PNG only).

name: generate_qr_code
title: Generate QR code
